rows.hook: New metrics planned for Viksit Bharat goal
rows.summary: MoSPI Secretary Saurabh Garg stated at an event that India periodically updates its GDP measurement framework to capture structural economic changes. The revision will incorporate expanding digital economy metrics, new products, and administrative data sources like GST and e-Vahan. Garg noted that these methodological updates could revise estimated GDP figures either upward or downward. The government aims to align national accounting with international standards by 2029-30. Indian retail investors track GDP revisions as they influence sovereign credit ratings, macroeconomic policy, and RBI interest rate decisions.
